description: This file defines the TaxService interface, which declares methods for retrieving and saving tax configurations, and calculating taxes for orders in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: TaxService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for managing tax configurations and calculating taxes on orders.

methods.name: getTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves tax configuration for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Persists the provided tax configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: calculateTax
methods.description: Calculates applicable taxes for a given order summary, customer, store, and language.
